meta.title: Frederic Abraham — Fullest-Stack Developer
meta.description: The career of Frederic Abraham as a scroll-driven 3D timeline: TU Berlin (B.Sc.), an M.Sc. in AI at Maastricht, and scaling AI products at Respeak in Berlin — GANs, embeddings, and RAG.
meta.ogDescription: A biographical 3D timeline: Berlin → Maastricht → Berlin. Generative AI, embeddings at scale, and retrieval-augmented generation.

hero.sr: Senior developer at Respeak in Berlin. I work across the whole stack, and most of my work involves AI: generative models in my master's, sentence embeddings for a game with 18,000 concurrent players, and now a retrieval-augmented generation platform.
hero.def: someone who, asked which part of the stack they work on, answers “yes”.

whoami: you: a person of evidently excellent taste.
out.catEmpty: cat: i need something to read. try 'ls' first.
out.stackExtra: …plus a frankly concerning amount of YAML.
out.contactPick: ↑ pick your poison — or type 'mail' and write me from right here.
orbit: drag to orbit, wheel to zoom. the bar at the bottom scrubs the whole run.
esc — or 'return to scroll' — brings you back where you left off.
out.ping: PONG. latency: Berlin → you. let's lower it — say hi.
out.sudoEmpty: sudo what? absolute power needs an object.
sudoHire: …to a position that's already filled. happily, at Respeak.
out.sudoRm: 🙅 not on my watch, not even with sudo.
sudoOther: nope — you already have root over your own career. 😉
out.rm: 🙅 nice try — everything here is load-bearing.
out.vim: you're in vim now. (jk — :q worked, unlike for most people.)
out.exit: there is no exit — only scroll. (the window's X works, though.)
out.matrix: 🟢 wake up… the head's been in the matrix this whole time.
hire: flattered — but not looking. I'm happily building at Respeak.
a good problem is always welcome, though: 'mail' me about yours.
out.coffee: always. ☕ type 'mail' and tell me where.
out.sl: 🚂 woo woo… (you typed it too fast, didn't you.)
